sections.text: The chromosome 19 deletion creates an in-frame DNAJB1::PRKACA fusion characteristic of fibrolamellar carcinoma. Engineering the homologous fusion in adult mouse liver produced tumors resembling fibrolamellar carcinoma.

report_comment.text: DNAJB1 encodes an HSP40-family cochaperone that regulates HSP70 activity. PRKACA encodes the alpha catalytic subunit of cyclic-AMP-dependent protein kinase A. The chromosome 19 deletion creates an in-frame DNAJB1::PRKACA fusion characteristic of fibrolamellar carcinoma. Engineering the homologous fusion in adult mouse liver produced tumors resembling fibrolamellar carcinoma.
